portals.name: NASA Earthdata Search
portals.description: NASA's primary portal for discovering and accessing Earth science observations, including MODIS LST, MODIS NDVI, MAIAC AOD, SRTM DEM, and GPM precipitation.

portals.name: NASA Worldview
portals.description: Interactive environment for visually exploring daily NASA satellite imagery and environmental observations.

portals.name: NASA Planetary Data System (PDS)
portals.description: Long-term archive for planetary science data from NASA orbital, lander, and rover missions spanning imagery, geoscience, atmospheres, and cartography.

portals.name: NASA Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO)
portals.description: Orbital observations of the lunar surface including LOLA (topography/slope/roughness), LROC (imagery), LEND (neutron/water), and Mini-RF.

portals.name: NASA LRO Diviner Lunar Radiometer
portals.description: Maps lunar surface temperature and provides polar thermal products, cold-trap maps, and rock abundance products.

portals.name: RADARSAT Constellation Mission (RCM) Data
portals.description: Trio of Earth observation satellites providing C-band SAR for surface roughness, terrain, ice, and maritime monitoring.

portals.name: RADARSAT-1 Open Data Archive
portals.description: Historical SAR imagery operating day/night through cloud cover under an open data license.

portals.name: CSA Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) Python Tutorial
portals.description: Methods and Python routines for processing SAR imagery for surface roughness and texture extraction.

portals.name: Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
portals.description: Free and open access to Sentinel Earth-observation data (Sentinel-1 SAR, Sentinel-2 Multispectral NDVI, Sentinel-3 SLSTR LST, Copernicus DEM GLO-30).

portals.name: ESA Open Science Catalog
portals.description: Public geoscience datasets, products, experiments, and workflows.

portals.name: JAXA G-Portal
portals.description: Satellite Earth observation products including precipitation (GSMaP), snow/ice, and vegetation metrics.
